title: Deliverable 660629: [29.x] BCApps part of No Receipt expenses
summary: The Expense Agent now allows users to submit expenses with missing original receipts by selecting a Lost Receipt option, with the system generating a standardized declaration document and enforcing mandatory approver review.
key_points: New Lost Receipt functionality lets users mark expenses without original receipts
System automatically generates a standardized Lost Receipt declaration document based on expense data
Enhanced compliance controls require mandatory approver review for no-receipt expenses
New enums for Expense Compliance Status and Expense No Receipt Type added
New management codeunit and report created to handle no-receipt declarations
